source_observations.claim: AgentSight is a system-level observability stack whose source architecture separates eBPF/native capture, normalized event streams, analysis/materialized views, SQLite/OTel sinks, protocol surfaces and CLI/web presentation.

Linux eBPF capture observes process lifecycle and SSL/TLS plaintext boundaries; privileged capture requires sudo/root-equivalent eBPF capability, while some top/report/native-session paths can operate without eBPF.

The AgentSight materialized SQLite view stores independent rows for LLM calls, tool calls, process nodes, audit events, resource samples, token usage and network targets, including view_source/confidence fields on relevant rows.

AgentSight can export captured LLM calls as OpenTelemetry GenAI spans over OTLP/HTTP; prompt/completion content export is opt-in and off by default. Tool/workflow spans are explicitly not emitted yet and AgentSight-specific provenance remains in its own rows.

The full collector is a nontrivial Rust/eBPF/web stack (Rust 1.87, internal capture/protocol/session/visualization crates, rusqlite, Tokio, Hyper and other dependencies), so wholesale embedding would materially enlarge the F2 runtime/dependency surface.
The upstream README reports less than 3 percent CPU overhead for typical traced agent workloads. This run did not reproduce that number and grants it zero F2 performance credit.

f2_architecture_mapping.current_f2_gap: F2-WP-005 Full telemetry/data spine and collectors remains IN_PROGRESS; child performance telemetry and whole-system characterization/failure-injection work remain open.
recommended_boundary: Keep UnifiedDB as the sole canonical state/evidence authority.
Keep EffectGate/EffectJournal as the sole real-effect authority.
Treat AgentSight SQLite as an external derived/materialized observer store, never a second truth database.
Import only typed observations into F2 through a provenance-bound TelemetryWitnessEnvelope or equivalent adapter.
Prefer metadata-only OTLP/JSON/SQLite read-only ingestion first; do not enable captured prompt/completion content unless a bounded experiment explicitly needs it and sanitization is proven.
Bind observer version/commit, collection mode, privilege mode, target process identity/tree, source timestamps, F2 causal IDs when available, event/content digest, view_source and confidence.
Preserve unmatched or ambiguous correlations as UNKNOWN rather than inventing causal linkage.
f2_architecture_mapping.why_not_wholesale_import: F2 already requires its own canonical telemetry/data spine and causal identity. AgentSight's largest unique value is an observer outside application-controlled logging. Its separate database, web UI and full capture stack are useful as a witness but would create duplication and authority confusion if treated as canonical F2 state.

candidate_mechanisms_to_distill: Independent process-tree and system-boundary observation outside agent self-report.
Explicit view_source/confidence on materialized observer rows.
Read-only/offline querying of recorded observer SQLite.
Metadata-first OpenTelemetry GenAI export with content capture disabled by default.
Correlation of model traffic with process/file/network/resource evidence while preserving observer provenance.
Fallback modes using native agent session data when privileged eBPF capture is unavailable.

counterhypotheses_and_risks.claim: F2-native telemetry may already provide enough causal evidence; AgentSight could duplicate signals without improving error detection or falsification power.
counterhypotheses_and_risks.falsifier: A controlled A/B workload where AgentSight catches material subprocess/file/network/resource effects or attribution errors missed by the F2 telemetry spine at acceptable overhead.

counterhypotheses_and_risks.claim: Privileged eBPF/TLS tracing may be operationally too expensive or unsafe for default deployment.
counterhypotheses_and_risks.falsifier: A bounded Linux experiment showing required capture completeness with acceptable privileges, isolation, privacy controls and overhead; otherwise retain only unprivileged/native-session mechanisms.

counterhypotheses_and_risks.claim: A second mutable observer database can become a de facto competing truth store and create stale/conflicting state.
counterhypotheses_and_risks.falsifier: Adapter tests prove one-way provenance-bound observation ingestion, no authority writes from AgentSight state, deterministic dedupe and explicit disagreement/UNKNOWN handling.

counterhypotheses_and_risks.claim: Boot-relative timestamps, provider/session grouping and external process correlation may not align reliably with F2 causal identities.
counterhypotheses_and_risks.falsifier: Exact-bound test fixtures show stable event alignment across process spawn, tool invocation, observer timestamps and F2 causal IDs, including negative mismatches that fail closed.

counterhypotheses_and_risks.claim: TLS plaintext capture can collect prompts, responses, paths, headers or other sensitive material beyond what F2 needs.
counterhypotheses_and_risks.falsifier: Metadata-only capture/export proves sufficient for the target telemetry hypotheses; content remains disabled and temporary artifacts pass a secret/sensitive-data fence.

next_exact_discriminator.goal: Determine whether AgentSight adds independent falsification power beyond F2-native telemetry at acceptable operational cost.
next_exact_discriminator.experiment: On an explicitly authorized isolated Linux test surface, run a deterministic no-real-external-effect fixture that spawns child processes, writes only inside a temporary directory, performs loopback-only network I/O and emits known F2 internal telemetry. Compare AgentSight disabled vs enabled and reconcile both evidence streams.
measure: capture completeness and false-positive rate for known process/file/loopback events
correlation accuracy against immutable F2 causal/tool/child IDs
behavior when eBPF is unavailable or correlation is ambiguous
next_exact_discriminator.promotion_rule: Only reproducible net evidence benefit can advance to E3/E4. E5 additionally requires an exact integration plan and measured F2 benefit; E6 remains Trigger-4-only.

mirror_state.reason: Persist the source-grounded research packet without treating a binary DB rewrite or private Actions transport as implicitly safe/atomic.
